title: ‘Like working in a kettle’: France’s overcrowded prisons swelter under historic heatwave
summary: The deadly heatwave sweeping France has once again exposed the structural problems of the country’s chronically overcrowded prisons, with groups of three or four detainees crammed into airless cells built to hold a lone prisoner.
